verdict.line: You lose if Kled lands Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) into a double Jousting dash before level 6; you win if you survive to Blade of the Ruined King and punish him the moment Skaarl dismounts.

brief.thesis: Kled's entire kit is built around an early burst all-in — hook with Q (Bear Trap on a Rope), then dash in and back out with E (Jousting) — that outpaces Irelia before she has passive stacks or items, which is why Kled holds both the lane edge and the solo-kill edge at a 44.2% Irelia win rate over 77 games. That burst collapses the instant Skaarl's mount health empties, because Kled's abilities change and he deals less damage to champions while dismounted — that is the one moment your stacked Ionian Fervor and Q (Bladesurge) resets actually win the fight.

theirWindow.when: Kled mounted, Q and E both up
theirWindow.what: He can hook you with Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) and chain into E (Jousting) and its recast dash-back for a full burst combo. Do not contest trades here — hold position outside his 800-range Q.

yourWindow.what: Dismounted Kled deals less damage to champions and his Q becomes the knockback Pocket Pistol. Commit everything now — Bladesurge resets off a Marked target so you can double-tap Q through the kill window.

boots.why: 52.4% win rate over 82 games at 89.1% pick — flattens the burst from his W (Violent Tendencies) empowered autos and the physical hits from Jousting.

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking adaptive force and healing offset his early burst advantage and let you win the extended fights that start once he dismounts.

summoners.why: 47.5% win rate at 81.6% pick — Ignite punishes his all-in trades and cuts into the health he needs to restore Skaarl's courage, while Flash gets you out of Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) range.

playing.title: Track Skaarl's health bar
playing.detail: Dismounting removes his damage bonus to champions. That's your signal to commit, not level or cooldowns.

playing.title: Respect Q range at 800
playing.detail: Don't walk into Bear Trap on a Rope range when his Q and E are both up — being shackled and yanked in is how you lose the trade outright.

playing.title: Trade after double Jousting
playing.detail: Once he's used E (Jousting) and its recast to dash back, both charges are down for 13/12/11/10/9s. He has no reposition tool — step in now.

playing.title: Bank 4 passive stacks first
playing.detail: Only engage once Ionian Fervor is at max stacks for the bonus on-hit damage. Don't throw E (Flawless Duet) just to proc it if the mark will whiff.

playing.title: Eat his W with your W
playing.detail: Violent Tendencies gives him four empowered attacks with a harder fourth hit. Time Defiant Dance's damage reduction into that window specifically.

playing.title: Mark, then double-reset Q
playing.detail: Land E to Mark him, which refreshes Bladesurge's cooldown on hit — chain two Q casts back to back once he's dismounted and low.

playing.title: Don't contest levels 1-3
playing.detail: His hook-into-dash all-in wins those trades outright. Wait for Blade of the Ruined King and Hullbreaker before forcing skirmishes.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (77-game sample for this specific matchup); the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own read of the kits.
